svg.title: fig4_determinism
svg.desc: Bit-identical compares SHA-256 digests of canonical full trace rows (step, truth, observation, metrics, and info); the sensor toggle compares truth only and Node↔tensor uses its reduced-state contract. The Node↔tensor cell reports maximum divergence; N/A cells retain their reason.
